caption: The drawing depicts a single garment, specifically a long dress or gown, positioned centrally on a plain, light beige background. The dress is rendered in shades of gray and black, giving it a monochromatic appearance. It has a high neckline, long sleeves that are gathered at the cuffs, and a fitted waist. The dress buttons up the front with a row of buttons visible from the neckline down past the waist. The skirt of the dress is floor-length and appears full with visible folds and creases suggesting draped fabric. The dress is presented from the front and there are no other objects or patterns in the composition.
title: Lady's Evening Coat
